diagram_math_checks.justification: Each row is one hidden state s_i in S={s_0,s_1}; columns record prior/prediction mass, joint probability of S_1=s_i and O_1=x, and posterior probability given x. Arrows act on numeric masses, not on S; this is explicitly stated in Remarks. Existing Example gives H=1 and action a with deterministic (s_i,0) transition; verification 1.1 therefore establishes prediction equals prior.

The four arrows are left-to-right calculations. Top first arrow multiplies 3/4 by O(x|s_0)=3/4 to obtain 9/16; bottom first arrow multiplies 1/4 by O(x|s_1)=1/4 to obtain 1/16. These are exactly Example inputs and the joint-law convention in def-finite-pomdp; no cross-state edge is asserted.

Verification 2.1 gives q(x|b_0,a)=9/16+1/16=5/8>0. The two second arrows divide by 5/8, giving 9/10 and 1/10 as in verification 3.1 and Fact F2. Both posterior masses sum to 1; their ratio is 9:1, whereas prior ratio is 3:1.

Caption retains O(y|s_0)=1/4 and O(y|s_1)=3/4 from Example, so each observation distribution sums to 1. It explicitly restricts picture to observed x; no posterior for y is invented. Original three-step verification remains byte-identical and independent of the figure.

This is two disjoint directed chains of length two: six vertices, four edges; degrees are (out 1,in 0), (out 1,in 1), (out 0,in 1) in each row. Native SVG contains six box paths, four horizontal arrow shafts and four rightward arrowheads (14 paths total). No cycle/closing edge or open/closed endpoint convention is asserted.
